name: Honey Baked Ham
blocked: Chain SPA that only prices after a client-side store pick. The work list's own store URL (stores/8914) and every other path tried (/menu, /shop, /products) all return the identical 52KB webpack shell (Account/Application/Base/CMS/Cart/Checkout/Products/StoreLocator/User bundles) with no server-rendered content -- only 2 dollar figures anywhere on the page, both from an unrelated '$9.99 Lunch Meal Offer' promo blurb, not itemized product prices. Grepped every JS bundle (Products, Application, CMS, Cart, Checkout, StoreLocator, routers, main, vendor -- ~850KB total) for an API host, REST path, or GraphQL endpoint and found none; api.honeybaked.com only serves static assets (fonts, images, chat/qr scripts) in what was checked. This needs a browser to select the store (guid tied to store 8914, 4299 Genesee Avenue) and watch what the SPA fetches for its product/price data -- naming the exact gap so a Chrome-equipped agent can finish it in one page load.
notes: Per playbook section 11, never record a chain not-found before selecting a store -- this IS the correct store page from the work list, it simply renders nothing server-side. Real prices plausibly exist (HoneyBaked Ham sells priced hams/turkeys/sides year-round) but none could be read without a browser.
